description: This header file defines functions and constants related to handling hexadecimal representations of object IDs and hashes in a Git-like version control system. It includes functions for reading, converting, and parsing hashes and object IDs, supporting multiple hash algorithms.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Reads a hexadecimal hash string and converts it into binary form, supporting different hash algorithms.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop_r
methods.description: Converts a binary hash to its hexadecimal string representation in a reentrant manner, writing to the provided buffer.

methods.name: oid_to_hex_r
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hexadecimal string form in a reentrant way.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop
methods.description: Converts a hash in binary form to hexadecimal, using a static buffer for the return.

methods.name: oid_to_hex
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hexadecimal string, using a static buffer.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal string into an object ID, supporting specific hash algorithms.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Detects hash algorithm based on hex length and parses into an object ID.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Detects hash algorithm based on hex length and parses into an object ID.

methods.name: get_hash_hex
methods.description: Reads a hex string and converts it into binary hash form.

methods.name: get_oid_hex
methods.description: Reads a hex string and converts it into an object ID (simple variant).

methods.name: parse_oid_hex
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID (simple variant).

methods.name: hash_to_hex
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hex string using a static buffer.
